sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Act may be
called the Balochistan Education Foundation Act, 1994.
(2) It extends to the whole of the
Province of Balochistan, except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

Establishment of the foundation

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE FOUNDATION
3. Establishment of the Foundation.‑‑‑(1) There
shall, be established a Foundation to be known as Balochistan Education
Foundation for carrying out the purposes of this Act.
(2) The Foundation shall be a
body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to
acquire, hold and dispose of property, both movable and immovable, and shall by
its name sue and be sued.
(3) The head office of the Foundation shall be at
Quetta.

Management

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE FOUNDATION
4. Management: ‑‑(1)
I" he administration and management of the Foundation and its affairs
shall vest in the Board which may exercise the powers and do all acts and things
which may be exercised or done by the Foundation.
(2) The affairs of the
Foundation shall be conducted subject to the supervision and control of the
Government. .
(3) If any question arises as to whether any matter
is a matter of policy or not, the decision of the Government shall be final.

Constitution of the board

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE FOUNDATION
5. Constitution of the Board: ‑‑(1) There shall be a Board
of Directors of the Foundation consisting of such number of official and non‑official
members, including the Chairman, as may be appointed by the Government through
a Gazette notification. The Board shall consist of sixteen members including
the Chairman.
(2) The Chairman and members
other than an ex officio member, shall unless the Government otherwise directs,
hold office for a period of three years but he may be re‑appointed as
such for another term of three years or for such shorter term as the Government
may direct. .
(3) The Government may remove a member on the ground
of inefficiency, unsuitability or misconduct after giving him an opportunity of
being heard.
(4) The Chairman and any member may, by writing under
his hand addressed to the Government, resign from his office:
Provided that his resignation shall not take effect
until accepted by the Government.

Duties and functions of the chairman and members

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE FOUNDATION
6. Duties and functions of Chairman and members.‑‑‑(1)
The Chairman and members shall discharge such duties and perform such
functions, as assigned to them by or under this Act.
(2) Until the Board is duly constituted, the Chairman
shall, subject to such directions as the Government ‑may from time to
time give exercise the powers, discharge the duties and perform functions of
the Board.
(3) No act or proceedings of the Board shall be
invalid by reason only of the existence of a vacancy in, or any defect in the
constitution of the Board.
(4) A simple majority of the
members of the Board shall constitute the
quorum of the Board.
(5) The meeting of the Board
shall be held at such time and places and in such manner as the regulations may
provide:
Provided that until regulations are made in‑this behalf
the meeting of the Board shall be held as and when convened by the Chairman.
(6) The Board may constitute
such financial, technical and advisory committee as may be desired necessary for
carrying out the purposes pf this Act.

Appointment and functions of the managing director

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
7. Appointment and functions of the Managing Director: ‑‑(1)
The Government shall appoint a whole time Managing Director of the Foundation
whose Qualifications, terms and', conditions of service shall be such as may be determined by the regulations.
(2) Subject to subsection (4),
the terms of office of the Managing Director shall be three years but the Government
may extend the same for a period not exceeding one year at a time.
(3) The Managing Director shall
be the Chief Executive of the Foundation, he shall have to serve as member of
the Board also, and shall exercise effective control over and make all
decisions necessary for the smooth functioning of the day to day affairs of the
Foundation, under the general supervision of the Board.
(4) The Government may remove the Managing Director
on the ground of inefficiency, ,unsuitability or misconduct after giving him an
opportunity of being heard.
(5) In particular and without prejudice of generality
of the foregoing powers the Managing Director shall have the power and
responsibility to---‑‑
(a) exercise administrative control over the
officers, officials of the Foundation;
(b) exercise, in respect of the Foundation such other
management, administrative and financial powers as deemed appropriate by the
Foundation;
(c) submit the annual budget proposals of the
Foundation to the Board;
(d) maintain the accounts of the Foundation;
(e) prepare the annual report of the Foundation for
the Board and the Government;
(f) exercise such powers as the
Board may delegate to him; and
(g) act on behalf of the Foundation, in any emergency,
subject to the obligation to report such action to the Board at its next
meeting and to seek the Board's ratification of any action so taken.

Recruitment conditions of services of officers officials etc

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
8. Recruitment, conditions of
services of officers, officials etc: ‑‑The Foundation shall, by
regulation made with the prior approval of the Government, lay down the
procedure for the appointment of its officers, and officials and the terms and
conditions of their services, and shall be competent to take disciplinary
action against them, according to the prescribed rules.

Members and officers to be public servants

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
9. Members and officers to be
public servants: ‑‑The Chairman, members, officers and officials of
the Foundation shall, when acting or purporting to act in pursuance of any of
the provisions of this Act, be deemed to be public servants within the meaning
of section 21 of the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860).

Indemnity

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
10. Indemnity: ‑‑No
suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall be against the Foundation,
the Board, the Chairman or any member, officer or official of the Foundation in
respect of any thing done in good faith or intended to be done under this Act.

Members officers and officials not personally liable

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
11. Members, officers, officials not personally liable.‑‑‑(1)
The members, Directors, Advisers, officers and officials of the Foundation
shall be indemnified by the Foundation against all losses and expenses
sustained or incurred by him in the discharge of his duties, save such losses
and expenses as are sustained and incurred as a result of his own wilful act or
default.
(2) The Managing Director shall
not be personally responsible for the acts of any member, Director, Adviser,
officer or official of the Foundation which he could not. have reasonably
prevented by the due exercise of his powers and functions under this Act and
the rules and regulations made there under or for any loss or expense resulting
to the Foundation by reason of the insufficiency or deficiency in value of, or
title to any property or security acquired or taken on behalf of the Foundation
by the wrongful act of any person under a liability to the Foundation or anything
done by him in good faith in execution of the duties of his office.

Delegation of powers to chairman etc

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
12. Delegation of powers to Chairman etc: ‑‑The
Foundation or the Board may by general or special order, delegate to the
Chairman or a member or any officer, official of the Foundation, any of its
powers, duties or functions under this Act, subject to such conditions or
limitations as may be specified in the order.

Functions of the foundation

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER IV
POWERS AND DUTIES OF THE FOUNDATION
13. Function
of the Foundation: ‑‑(1) Subject to the other provisions of this
Act, the Foundation may take all such measures and exercise such powers as may
be necessary for the promotion, development and financing of Education and for
carrying out the purposes of this Act.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the functions mentioned in subsection (1) the Foundation shall‑‑‑
(a) assist the private sector
to establish educational institutions;
(b) give grants preferably to
non‑profit making private educational institutions for purchase of land,
construction of building, purchase of furniture, equipment and educational,
material including books, stationery and other such material;
(c) give loans to the private
sector institutions/organizations from the Foundation fund or assist in getting
loans from Scheduled Banks for the purposes mentioned in (2) (b);
(d) sell or lease plots or
assist the private sector in getting plots and land from Government,
Development Authorities and Housing Agencies controlled by the Government for
the establishment of educational institutions;
(e) perform such functions as‑‑‑
(i) preparing and submitting schemes to the
Government for the development of educational programmes and projects including
schemes for research and modernization of education;
(ii) giving effect to approved schemes mentioned in
sub‑clause (i) above;
(iii) improving teacher
training and other institutions;
(iv) encouraging the formation
of voluntary associations in furtherance of the purposes of this Act; and
(v) taking appropriate measures for integration and consolidation
of privately‑managed institutions and projects, regulation of fees in the
privately managed institutions particularly those receiving assistance from
the Government; and
(f) perform such other
functions as may be‑ assigned to it by the Government.

Balochistan health foundation fund

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
14. Balochistan Education
Foundation Fund: ‑‑(1) There shall be formed a fund to be known as the
Foundation Fund, which shall vest in the Foundation and shall be utilized by
the Foundation to meet the charges in connection with its functions under this
Act.
(2) To the credit of the Balochistan Education
Foundation Fund, shall be placed‑‑‑
(a) grants made by Government
and the Federal Government;
(b) income from investments
made by the Foundation;
(c) donations and endowments;
(d) revolving funds placed by the Government at the
disposal of the Foundation;
(e) grants made by the Local
Bodies; and
(f) all other sums received by
the Foundation and incomes from other sources.

Budget

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
15. Budget: ‑‑In the
month of November each year, the Foundation shall submit to the Government for
approval a statement of the estimated receipt and expenditure in rupees in
respect of the next financial year.
(2) In the manner prescribed by the Government, the Foundation
shall also submit to the Government for approval a statement of the estimated
receipt and expenditure in foreign exchange in respect of the next financial
year. .
(3) The Foundation shall obtain specific sanction of
the Government in respect of each individual scheme costing more than ten lac
rupees to be financed by the Foundation.

Audit and accounts

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
16. Audit and Accounts: ‑‑(1) The Foundation shall maintain
proper accounts and other relevant records and prepare annual statement of
accounts, including balance‑sheet in accordance with such general
directions As may be issued, and in such form as may be specified, by
Government.
(2) The accounts of the Foundation shall be audited
by two auditors who shall be chartered accountants within the meaning of
Chartered Accountants Ordinance, 1961 (X of 1961), appointed by the Foundation
with the approval of, the Government, on such remuneration, to be paid by the
Foundation as the Government may fix.
(3) Notwithstanding the provision of subsection (2)
the Accountant General, Balochistan, may, either of his own motion, or upon
request received in this behalf from the Government undertake such audit of the
accounts books and concerned documents at such place or places as the
Accountant- General, Balochistan may fix, and furnish such explanations and
information as the Accountant‑General, Balochistan or an officer
authorized by him in this behalf may ask for.
(4) Every auditor appointed under subsection (2)
shall be given a copy of the annual balance‑sheet of the Foundation and
shall examine it together with the accounts and vouchers relating thereto and
shall have a list delivered to him of all books kept by the Foundation; and
shall at all reasonable times have access to the books of accounts and other
documents of the Foundation and may in relation to such accounts examine any
officer of the Foundation.
(5) The auditors shall report to the Government upon the
annual balance‑sheet and accounts and in their report state whether in
their opinion the balance‑sheet is a full and fair balance‑sheet
containing all necessary particulars and properly drawn up so as to exhibit a
true and correct view of the state of the Foundation's affairs and, in case
they have called for any explanation or information from the Board, whether it
has been given and whether it is satisfactory.
(6) The Government may at any time issue directions
to the auditors requiring them to report to it upon the adequacy of measures
taken by the Foundation for the protection of the interests of the Government
and of the creditors of the Foundation or upon the sufficiency of their
procedure in auditing the accounts of the Foundation and may at any time
enlarge or extend the scope of the. audit or direct that a different procedure
in audit be adopted or that any other examination be made by the auditors if in
its opinion the public interest so requires.
(7) The Foundation shall comply with every direction
issued by the Government for the rectification of matters objected to in audit.

Accounts

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
17. Accounts: ‑‑The
Foundation shall, with the prior approval of the Government, open an account in
any Scheduled Bank of Pakistan.

Penalty

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VI
PENALTY AND PROCEDURE
18. Penalty: ‑‑Whoever
contravenes any provision of this Act or any rule or regulation made or scheme
sanctioned thereunder shall, if no other penalty is provided for such
contravention, be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to
six months or with fine, or with both. .
sections.punishment:
punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to
six months or with fine, or with both.

sections.description:
Cognizance of offences

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VI
PENALTY AND PROCEDURE
19. Cognizance of offence: ‑‑No
Court other than a Court of Magistrate 1st Class shall take cognizance of any
offence punishable under this Act, on a complaint in writing made by the
Foundation or an officer/official authorized for the purpose by the Foundation.
sections.punishment:
punishable under this Act, on a complaint in writing made by the
Foundation or an officer/official authorized for the purpose by the Foundation.

sections.description:
Submission of yearly report and returns

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
20. Submission of yearly report and returns: ‑‑(1) The
Foundation shall submit to the Government, as soon as possible after the end of
every financial year but before the last day of December next following a
report on the conduct of its affairs for that year.
(2) The Government may, after giving sufficient
notice to the Foundation, require it to furnish the Government with‑‑‑
(i) any return, statement, estimates, statistics, or other
information regarding any matter under the control of the Foundation; or
(ii) a report on any subject with which the
Foundation is concerned; or
(iii) a copy of any document in the charge of
Foundation; and the Foundation shall comply with such requisition.

Board not responsible for certain acts of its officers and officials

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
21. Board not responsible for certain acts of its officers and officials: ‑ The
Board shall not be responsible for any disfeasance, malfeasance and non feasance
of any officer or official appointed under this Act or of any person acting
under the authority of direction or in subordination to any such officer or
official.

Power to dispose of land

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
22. Power to dispose of land: ‑‑The
Foundation may retain, or may lease, sell, exchange, rent or otherwise dispose
of any land vested in it.

Power of foundation to make rules and regulations

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
23. Power of Foundation to make
rules and regulations: ‑‑The Foundation may, with the prior.
sanction of the Government, make rules and regulations for carrying out the
purpose of this Act.

Control of Government over acts and proceedings of the board

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
24. Control of Government over acts and proceedings of the Board: ‑‑All
Acts and proceedings of the Board shall be subject to the control of Government
and the Government may suspend or modify any such Act or proceedings.

Dissolution of foundation and transfer of its assets and liabilities

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
25. Dissolution of Foundation
and transfer of its assets and liabilities.‑‑ (1) The Government
may, by notification in the official Gazette, declare that the Foundation shall
be dissolved on such date as may be specified in such notification, and the
Foundation shall stand dissolved accordingly.
(2) On and from the said date‑‑‑
(a)(i) all properties, funds and‑ dues placed
at the disposal of the Foundation by Government; and
(ii) all properties, funds and dues exchanged,,
derived from, or otherwise attributable to the properties, funds and dues
referred to in sub clause (i), which immediately before the said date were held
by or were realisable by the Foundation, shall vest in, and be realisable by
the Government.
(b) All properties, funds, and dues, other than those
referred to in clause (a), which immediately before the. said date the
Foundation shall vest in and be realisable by the Government may determine, and
its decision thereon shall be final;
(c) all liabilities which immediately before the said
date, were enforceable against the Foundation shall be assumed by and be enforceable
against the Government or such agency as the Government determines under clause
(b), as the case may be; .
(d) for the purpose of completing the execution of
any scheme which has not been fully executed by the Foundation and of realising
properties, funds and dues referred to in clauses (a) and (b) as the case may
be; and
(e) the agency referred to in clauses (b), (c) and
(d) shall keep such accounts of all moneys, respectively received and expended
by it under this Act as the Government may prescribe,

Removal of difficulties

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
26. Removal of difficulties: ‑‑If
any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this Act
especially in respect of the adjustment of the powers, functions and
jurisdiction of the Foundation under this Act, the Government may make such
order as may appear to it to be necessary or expedient for the purpose of
removing the difficulty.

Repeal

ACT VII OF 1994
ACT VII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN EDUCATION FOUNDATION ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
27. Repeal: ‑The
Balochistan Education Foundation Ordinance, 1994 (IV of 1994), is hereby
repealed.
